changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate model references and normalized dataset names. Added CLEF-2021 as main dataset name rather than specifying subtask.
All extracted metrics are correct and properly normalized.
Removed placeholder 'None' values since no LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.

guideline: Evaluators rated sentences on two binary criteria: IsCheckWorthy (is the sentence worth checking?) and IsCentralClaim (is the sentence related to the central idea of the article?)

changes_made.explanation: Human evaluation criteria are accurately extracted and properly formatted.

overall_notes: The extraction quality is generally good. The paper focuses on document-level claim extraction with NLG components including extractive summarization (sentence extraction) and paraphrase generation (decontextualisation). Key NLG outputs are decontextualised claims generated through a multi-step pipeline. Human evaluation was conducted by a fact-checking professional on domain-specific criteria.
